import LindenstraussPolynomials.Extension

Limits along an ultrafilter

For a sequence (x_k) in the unit ball of X and a free ultrafilter \mathcal U on \mathbb N, z(f)=\lim_{k\to\mathcal U}f(x_k) defines a point z of the unit ball of X^{**} (eq:z), and the canonical extension at z is an iterated limit along \mathcal U (eq:ulpartial). Lower bounds that hold at every strictly increasing tuple of indices survive these limits.

noncomputable sectionopen scoped BigOperators Topologyopen Finset Filternamespace LindenstraussPolynomialsvariable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]variable {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X]

The free ultrafilter used for the limits.

abbrev 𝒰 : Ultrafilter ℕ := hyperfilter ℕ

Limit along 𝒰.

Lower bounds at strictly increasing tuples of indices larger than m survive the iterated limits defining the canonical extension at the ultrafilter limit point.
